questions.stem: 用動物測試新藥一直備受爭議，因為對實驗鼠有效的未必對人類也有效。
questions.answer: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial, because what works on laboratory mice does not necessarily work on humans.
accepted_answers: Using animals to test new drugs has always been a controversial issue, since what works for lab mice may not work for humans.
Testing new medicines on animals has been widely debated, because what is effective for laboratory mice is not always effective for humans.

patterns: what 引導的名詞子句（對實驗鼠有效的＝what works on laboratory mice）
動名詞片語當主詞（用動物測試新藥）

questions.stem: 要完全停止動物實驗不容易，但電腦模型已取代部分實驗，使許多動物免於受苦。
questions.answer: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely, but computer models have replaced some experiments, sparing many animals from suffering.
accepted_answers: It is difficult to end animal testing entirely, but computer models have taken the place of some experiments, sparing many animals from pain.
It is hard to stop testing on animals completely, but some experiments have been replaced by computer models, sparing many animals from pain.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使許多動物免於受苦）
虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要完全停止…不容易）

1.explanation_zh: 「用動物測試新藥」是一個動作，當主詞時用動名詞片語 Testing new drugs on animals（視為單數，助動詞用 has）。「一直備受爭議」從過去延續到現在，用現在完成式 has long been controversial 或 has been widely debated。「對實驗鼠有效的」省略了中心名詞，英文用 what works on laboratory mice（＝the things that work on laboratory mice）當子句主詞，what 子句視為單數，所以後面是 does not necessarily work。「實驗鼠」是 laboratory mice（lab mice），mouse 的複數是 mice。「未必」用 not necessarily，也可以寫 may not。
evidence: 用動物測試新藥一直備受爭議
對實驗鼠有效的未必對人類也有效
1.strategy_zh: 先找出兩個主詞：句首的動作（寫成動名詞）和 because 子句裡沒有中心名詞的「…的」（寫成 what 子句）。
hints: 切成四段：用動物測試新藥／一直備受爭議／因為對實驗鼠有效的／未必對人類也有效
標的詞彙：test（測試）、drug（藥物）、controversial（有爭議的）、laboratory（實驗室的）、mouse（老鼠，複數 mice）、human（人類）
句型框架：V-ing … + has long been + adj., because what + V … + does not necessarily + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「要…不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to VR，把長的不定詞片語移到後面。「已取代部分實驗」用現在完成式 have replaced some experiments，也可以改用被動 some experiments have been replaced by computer models。「，使許多動物免於受苦」是前一件事帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 sparing／saving many animals from suffering（spare sb from N：使某人免於…）；from 後面要接名詞 suffering 或 pain。
evidence: 要完全停止動物實驗不容易
2.strategy_zh: 主幹用 It is not easy to …, but …；結果放在句尾，用 V-ing 分詞片語接上，不要再多寫一個動詞。
hints: 切成四段：要完全停止動物實驗不容易／但電腦模型已取代部分實驗／使許多動物／免於受苦
標的詞彙：completely（完全地）、replace（取代）、experiment（實驗）、suffering（痛苦、受苦）
句型框架：It is not easy to VR …, but S + have p.p. …, sparing + O + from + N

references: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial, because what works on laboratory mice does not necessarily work on humans.
Using animals to test new drugs has always been a controversial issue, since what works for lab mice may not work for humans.
Testing new medicines on animals has been widely debated, because what is effective for laboratory mice is not always effective for humans.

patterns.label_zh: what 引導的名詞子句（對實驗鼠有效的＝what works on laboratory mice）
patterns.frame: because + what + V … + does not necessarily + V …

patterns.label_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（用動物測試新藥）

accepted: Testing new drugs on animals
Using animals to test new drugs
Testing new medicines on animals
Using animals to test new medicines
To test new drugs on animals

common_errors.wrong: Test new drugs on animals has long been controversial
common_errors.right: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語當主詞要改成動名詞 Testing …（或不定詞 To test …），原形動詞不能當主詞。

common_errors.wrong: Testing new drugs on animals have long been controversial
common_errors.right: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，助動詞用 has。

accepted: has long been controversial
has always been a controversial issue
has been widely debated
has always been controversial
has long been a subject of debate
has been debated for a long time

common_errors.explanation_zh: be 動詞後面要接形容詞 controversial；controversy 是名詞「爭議」。
「備受爭議」不能逐字翻成 receive many arguments；用 be controversial 或 be widely debated。

accepted: because what works on laboratory mice
since what works for lab mice
because what is effective for laboratory mice
because what works on lab mice
because what works for laboratory mice

common_errors.right: because what works on laboratory mice
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「對實驗鼠有效的」省略了中心名詞，英文要用 what 子句當主詞，不能只寫動詞。

common_errors.wrong: because which works on laboratory mice
common_errors.right: because what works on laboratory mice
common_errors.explanation_zh: which 前面要有先行詞；沒有被修飾的名詞時用 what（＝the thing that）。

common_errors.wrong: because what works on laboratory mouses
common_errors.right: because what works on laboratory mice
common_errors.explanation_zh: mouse 的複數是不規則的 mice。

accepted: does not necessarily work on humans
may not work for humans
is not always effective for humans
does not necessarily work for humans
may not work on humans
might not work on humans

common_errors.wrong: do not necessarily work on humans
common_errors.right: does not necessarily work on humans
common_errors.explanation_zh: what 子句當主詞視為單數，助動詞用 does。

common_errors.wrong: does not necessary work on humans
common_errors.right: does not necessarily work on humans
common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞 work 要用副詞 necessarily。

traps.literal_error: Testing new drugs on animals has received many arguments.
traps.explanation_zh: 「備受爭議」是抽象概念，英文用形容詞 controversial 或 be widely debated；逐字翻成 receive many arguments 不是英文的說法。

traps.literal_error: because works on laboratory mice does not necessarily work on humans
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「對實驗鼠有效的」省略了中心名詞直接當主詞；英文要補 what，形成名詞子句 what works on laboratory mice，後面的 does 才有主詞。

bonus.text: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial, for there is no guarantee that what works on laboratory mice will also work on humans.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 there is no guarantee that …（不能保證…）改寫「未必」，再以 for 引導理由，語氣較正式。

1.restructuring_zh: 「用動物測試新藥」這個動作當主詞，英文改成動名詞片語 Testing new drugs on animals；「對實驗鼠有效的」沒有中心名詞，要改寫成 what 名詞子句 what works on laboratory mice，當 because 子句的主詞。

references: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely, but computer models have replaced some experiments, sparing many animals from suffering.
It is difficult to end animal testing entirely, but computer models have taken the place of some experiments, sparing many animals from pain.
It is hard to stop testing on animals completely, but some experiments have been replaced by computer models, sparing many animals from pain.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使許多動物免於受苦）
patterns.frame: S + have p.p. …, sparing/saving + O + from + N

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要完全停止…不容易）
patterns.frame: It is not + adj. + to VR …

parts.zh: 要完全停止動物實驗不容易
accepted: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely
It is difficult to end animal testing entirely
It is hard to stop testing on animals completely
It is not easy to completely stop animal testing
It is not easy to stop animal experiments completely

common_errors.wrong: Completely stop animal testing is not easy
common_errors.right: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語不能直接當主詞；用虛主詞 It is not easy to VR …（或 To stop … is not easy）。

common_errors.wrong: It is not easy to stopping animal testing completely
common_errors.right: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is … to 後面接原形動詞。

parts.zh: 但電腦模型已取代部分實驗
accepted: but computer models have replaced some experiments
but computer models have taken the place of some experiments
but some experiments have been replaced by computer models
but computer models have already replaced some experiments
but computer models have replaced some of the experiments

common_errors.wrong: but computer models have replaced by some experiments
common_errors.right: but computer models have replaced some experiments
common_errors.explanation_zh: 電腦模型是「取代者」，主動的 replace 直接接受詞；若以實驗當主詞，才用被動 have been replaced by。

common_errors.wrong: but computer models replace some experiment
common_errors.right: but computer models have replaced some experiments
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「已取代」用現在完成式；some 後面接可數名詞的複數 experiments。

accepted: sparing many animals
saving many animals
allowing many animals

common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後面直接接原形動詞會變成第二個沒有連接詞的動詞；表結果用分詞 sparing。
「使…免於」用 save／spare sb from N；make sb not VR 不自然。

accepted: from suffering
from pain
to avoid suffering
from great pain

common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 from 後面接名詞或動名詞 suffering，不能接原形動詞。

traps.zh: 要完全停止動物實驗不容易
traps.literal_error: Completely stop animal testing is not easy, but computer models have replaced some experiments.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿「完全停止動物實驗」這個動作當主詞；英文要用虛主詞 It is not easy to VR，或改成動名詞／不定詞主詞。
「受苦」在中文是動詞，放在 from 後面要變成抽象名詞 suffering 或 pain，不能用原形動詞。

bonus.text: Difficult as it is to end animal testing completely, computer models have already replaced some experiments, sparing countless animals unnecessary pain.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用讓步倒裝 Adj. + as + it is to VR 代替 It is … but …；spare sb sth（使某人免受…）是雙受詞用法。只當加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「要完全停止動物實驗不容易」以動作當主詞，英文改用虛主詞 It is not easy to …；「，使許多動物免於受苦」不另起一句，用句尾分詞 sparing many animals from suffering 表示前面整件事帶來的結果。

1.translation: Testing new drugs on animals has long been controversial, because what works on lab mice does not necessarily work on humans.
1.explanation_zh: 「一直備受爭議」從過去延續到現在，用現在完成式 has long been controversial；動名詞片語 Testing new drugs on animals 當主詞；「對實驗鼠有效的」沒有先行詞，用 what 名詞子句當 because 子句的主詞；「未必」譯 not necessarily。

2.translation: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely, but computer models have already replaced some of the experiments, saving many animals from suffering.
2.explanation_zh: 「要…不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to…；「已取代」用現在完成式；「使許多動物免於受苦」是前一句的結果，用句尾分詞 saving … from suffering 表結果，避免 and make 的鬆散寫法。

1.translation: Testing new drugs on animals has always been controversial because what works for laboratory mice does not necessarily work for humans.
1.explanation_zh: 「一直備受爭議」用現在完成式 has always been controversial；「用動物測試新藥」用動名詞片語當主詞；「對實驗鼠有效的未必對人類也有效」用名詞子句 what works … 加部分否定 does not necessarily。

2.translation: It is not easy to stop animal testing completely, but computer models have replaced some experiments, saving many animals from suffering.
2.explanation_zh: 「要完全停止動物實驗不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to …；「已取代部分實驗」用現在完成式；「使許多動物免於受苦」用現在分詞片語 saving … from suffering 表結果。
